_about: Daily Market Report one-line descriptions, keyed by the stored code. Read by momentum-api (web) and analyst-bot (Discord); edit here and nowhere else.

bond_equity_60d.deflationary_hedge: Bond prices and stocks moved in opposite directions over the window (ρ ≤ −0.25).
bond_equity_60d.inflationary_positive: Bond prices and stocks moved together over the window (ρ ≥ 0.25).
bond_equity_60d.transition_neutral: No clear link between bond prices and stocks over the window.

oil_equity_60d.decoupled: Stocks and oil moved in opposite directions over the window (ρ ≤ −0.25).
oil_equity_60d.neutral_mixed: No clear link between stocks and oil over the window.
oil_equity_60d.procyclical: Stocks and oil moved together over the window (ρ ≥ 0.25).

vix_equity_60d.compressed_link: Only a weak link between stock returns and VIX changes over the window.
vix_equity_60d.typical_fear_greed: Stocks rose as the VIX fell, and fell as it rose (ρ ≤ −0.25).
vix_equity_60d.unusual_positive: Stocks and the VIX moved in the same direction (ρ ≥ 0.15).

macro_regime.disinflation_soft_landing: Growth in expansion, with inflation not hot, policy not restrictive and credit spreads contained.
macro_regime.global_liquidity_stress: The Global stance is elevated stress, with a strong dollar or a yen carry unwind.
macro_regime.goldilocks_light: Inflation moderate, policy not restrictive, growth in expansion and credit spreads contained.
macro_regime.neutral_mixed: The stances do not match any of the listed patterns.
macro_regime.recession_pipeline: Yield curve inverted or re-steepening, credit spreads elevated, and growth weak.
macro_regime.rising_inflation_tight_policy: Inflation hot, Monetary Policy restrictive, and the yield curve flat, inverted or re-steepening.
macro_regime.stagflation_risk: The Inflation stance is hot while the Growth stance is slowdown or contraction.

market_cycle.bear_structural: Price phase bear: SPY's drawdown from its one-year high is in the bear band. The macro stances do not change this reading.
market_cycle.bull_fragile_global: Price phase bull extended, with the Global stance elevated stress or moderate.
market_cycle.bull_macro_aligned: Price phase bull, with the macro stances adding up above the aligned threshold.
market_cycle.bull_macro_divergent: Price phase bull, with the macro stances adding up below the divergent threshold.
market_cycle.bull_overextended: Price phase bull extended, with neither hot inflation under tight policy nor global stress.
market_cycle.correction_risk: Price phase correction: SPY's drawdown from its one-year high is in the correction band.
market_cycle.crash_panic: Price phase crash: SPY has fallen sharply against its recent highs. The macro stances do not change this reading.
market_cycle.insufficient_equity_data: Fewer than 200 daily bars of SPY stored, so there is no reading.
market_cycle.late_cycle_stretched: Price phase bull extended, with the Inflation stance hot and Monetary Policy restrictive or neutral.
market_cycle.neutral_mixed: Price phase bull: above the 200-day average and near the one-year high.
market_cycle.pullback_healthy: Price phase pullback: SPY is a little below its one-year high.
market_cycle.trend_soft: Price phase below the 200-day average, without a deep drawdown.

seasonality_disclaimer: A fixed reference table, not computed from market data; no reading on this page uses it.
